name: alt
description: Read and summarize your Alt lecture and meeting notes.

interface.longDescription: Read your Alt lecture and meeting notes, transcripts, and existing summaries. Ask for decisions, action items, or a recap grounded in the notes available to your connected account. Requires an Alt account with integration access and OAuth authorization. Only notes with a finished recording or a generated summary are available. This integration reads note data; it does not edit notes, start recordings, or return audio files.
defaultPrompt: List my available lecture and meeting notes.
Summarize the decisions from one of my meeting notes.
Extract action items from a meeting transcript.

positive.prompt: List up to five notes available in my Alt account.
positive.expected_behavior: Return at most five accessible notes with their titles and available dates. Explain an empty result without inventing notes.

positive.prompt: Show the details and transcript and summary readiness of one available Alt note.
positive.expected_behavior: Select a note returned by list_notes and retrieve its current metadata using its real note ID.

positive.prompt: Read the transcript of an available Alt note whose transcript is ready.
positive.expected_behavior: Choose a note with a ready transcript, retrieve its transcript, and follow content pagination when needed. Identify the note and distinguish returned content from any unexamined remainder.

positive.prompt: Give me a concise recap of an Alt note whose summary is ready.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve a ready note summary and relevant subsequent pages. Produce a concise recap grounded in the returned summary and identify the source note.

positive.prompt: From an available Alt meeting transcript, extract decisions and action items. Include owners and deadlines only when stated.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the selected meeting transcript and any needed subsequent pages. Separate decisions from action items; mark missing owners or deadlines as unspecified. If none are present, say so.

negative.prompt: Start recording a new meeting in Alt.
Read private Alt notes from another account that I have not connected.

review.commerce_description: The plugin reads existing notes and does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with OAuth-authorized access to note lists, metadata, transcripts, and summaries.

ko-KR.subtitle: 강의·회의 노트 조회와 요약
ko-KR.description: 연결한 Alt 계정에서 강의·회의 노트, 전사, 기존 요약을 읽고 결정 사항과 할 일을 정리합니다. 연동 권한이 있는 Alt 계정과 OAuth 승인이 필요합니다. 녹음이 종료되었거나 요약이 생성된 노트만 조회할 수 있으며, 노트 수정·녹음 시작·오디오 파일 반환은 지원하지 않습니다.
